turns.question: Which kind of customer call left people happiest in September 2026, and in what share of those calls?
turns.answer: Product calls, where 75% of the 16 labelled calls (1-30 September 2026) ended in a positive mood; delivery, pricing and returns calls showed no positive-sentiment share at all. These are model-derived labels (gemini-3.5-flash, prompt v1), not recorded values, and the semantic layer's end date is exclusive of 30 September only if the filter is; the figure covers 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30. Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
